name: Sonic After the Sequel: Rebirth
summary:
Sonic After the Sequel: Rebirth is a project that aims to completely remake and reimagine Sonic After the Sequel on Harmony Framework, featuring two new ways to experience the game:

"Classic" Mode: A faithful remake of the original 2013 version of the game with plenty of quality of life improvements.

"Rebirth" Mode: The entire game completely reimagined and brought up to modern fangame standards. Brand new character sprites, level art and backgrounds etc, new level design, an improved story, among other things.
